answer: Each identity buys canyon bandwidth through one link, locking a 70-credit bond and paying a fee on a meadow ledger. The k-th identity on the link pays 30+8(k-1): the 1000th pays 8022, and 1000 fakes pay 4,026,000 plus 70,000 locked. Each raven packet receipt binds packet, key and epoch; reused receipts are rejected, and an auditor recomputes bandwidth against the canyon meter and burns the bond on mismatch. A rented-packet ring fails because a rented receipt cannot carry another identity's traffic. An honest identity locks 70 once and pays 30 once, reclaiming it after a clean epoch.
